若 p 及 q 均為常數使得 x^2 + p ≡ (x + 2)(x + q) + 10，則 p =
A. -4
B. -2
C. 6
D. 10
reasoning: Expand RHS: (x+2)(x+q)+10 = x^2 + (q+2)x + 2q + 10. For the identity x^2 + p ≡ RHS for all x, the coefficient of x must be zero, so q+2 = 0 ⇒ q = -2. Then the constant term gives p = 2q + 10 = 2(-2) + 10 = 6. Hence p = 6, which corresponds to option C.
